comments.body: - [x] main entry point for library should be dist/instantsearch.js (to be compatible with every module loader)

I did the first releases of instantsearch.js, we have:
- up to date project on github, default branch is now master
- https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js
- online demo (updated at release or manually with npm run gh-pages): http://algolia.github.io/instantsearch.js/
- npm published (readme will be updated next release): https://www.npmjs.com/package/instantsearch.js
- published on jsdelivr: http://www.jsdelivr.com/projects/instantsearch.js with automatic update through npm
- no dist/ in github
- dist/ is in npm
- default export is dist/instantsearch.js in package.json
- single release command: npm run release hope you love it
- reproducible builds through npm-shrinkwrap.json
- version is now in instantsearch.version
- some badges and readme update
@vvo Could the online demo use the `dist` version + non-minified instantiations of the widgets instead of the `bundle.js`?
Oh yes I see what you mean, yeah it would be better. Ill do that now.
